reviews.comment: Excellent cable management. Great support for the graphics card. This case is very modular, and extremely easy to get into when you want to make a modification or adjustment. Super flexible on fan and CPU cooler placement. The lower panel has an optional frosted insert that looks fantastic with an ARGB string light behind it. Great buy.
